predeclared_objective.deployment_limits: owned Unix, literal-loopback Console/Agents, one issuer, schema 31
predeclared_objective.recovery_point: complete quiesced snapshot; zero accepted Console writes after snapshot
predeclared_objective.recovery_time_objective_end: both restored Agents acknowledge a higher signed sequence and live hooks match
predeclared_objective.recovery_time_objective_start: valid current archive restore begins after isolated negative controls

source.configuration: owned loopback, webhook source dispatcher disabled

stale_backup_negative.operator_guidance: Stop recovered Console; recover a current Console snapshot. Do not reset Agent sequence or signing trust. Reconciliation or a new epoch requires a separate reviewed procedure.

webhook_delivery.transport: cfg(test) native sender -> HMAC adapter -> existing authenticated Alertmanager receiver
